articles.title: Realty company Assetz to take confidential route for IPO
articles.content: Assetz, a Bengaluru developer, plans a Rs 1,200 crore initial public offering soon.  The proposed IPO will combine fresh equity issuance and an offer for sale.  JM Financial, BofA Securities India, and Motilal Oswal are lead managers.  This confidential filing allows initial prospectus secrecy until advanced stages.  Bengaluru's strong property market supports developer growth and project launches.

articles.title: Fed chief Warsh faces hard choice on inflation after bond market's 'red flag'
articles.content: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh faces a difficult choice regarding monetary policy.  His recent statements on inflation have unsettled bond markets significantly. This internal division creates uncertainty for future economic policy decisions.

articles.title: Apple set to lose nearly $500 billion in value after weak forecast
articles.content: Apple shares dropped significantly after a weak forecast indicated component shortages.  The AI boom is straining global supply chains, impacting chip availability for major tech firms.  This situation threatens to shrink both the personal computer and smartphone markets this year.  Apple's services business also showed weakness, worrying investors about future revenue streams.  Analysts are questioning Apple's supply chain leverage and the AI impact on its products.

articles.title: Rupee gains 30 paise to touch monthly high
articles.content: The Indian rupee closed at 95.38 on Friday, strengthening significantly. Persistent Reserve Bank of India interventions and lower oil prices aided this currency gain. The local unit traded within a narrow range during the trading session. A weaker dollar index also contributed to the rupee's upward movement. Analysts expect continued support for the rupee at lower levels.

articles.title: Bajaj Finserv Q1 net up 18% on NBFC strength
articles.content: Bajaj Finserv announced an eighteen percent profit increase for the June quarter. This growth was primarily fueled by strong consumer finance earnings. articles.title: IRDAI tightens ownership norms, eases capital infusion
articles.content: IRDAI has tightened oversight on insurer ownership changes and eased capital raising. Investors now need prior approval for shareholding changes exceeding five percent. The regulator also extended approval requirements to promoter group transfers. Dilution from existing shareholders not participating is now a transfer event. These amendments were announced late Friday by the authority.

articles.title: Sebi bans Zee's Subhash Chandra, Punit Goenka from markets for a year
articles.content: Sebi has barred Zee founder Subhash Chandra and CEO Punit Goenka from the securities market for one year. This action stems from an unauthorized pledge of company land to secure promoter group loans. The regulator also imposed a significant penalty on Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited. Shareholders approved a convertible warrant issuance, raising promoters' stake substantially. This development follows a previous investor rejection of a similar proposal.

articles.title: ITC Q1 profit plunges 27% due to record cigarette taxes and West Asia crisis
articles.content: ITC's first quarter net profit declined twenty-seven percent year-on-year. Record taxation on cigarettes significantly impacted the company's core business operations. The West Asia crisis also negatively affected agri-business exports during the period. However, the FMCG segment showed resilience with revenue and profit growth. Consumption remained steady across rural and urban markets despite inflation concerns.

articles.title: Maruti Suzuki Q1 profit drops 11% to Rs 3,352 crore amid rising input costs
articles.content: Maruti Suzuki reported an eleven percent profit decline in the June quarter. Rising input costs, aggravated by West Asia hostilities, impacted profitability significantly.  However, net sales climbed thirty-six percent to ₹49,959 crore during the same period. Unit sales also saw a strong twenty-nine percent increase, reaching a record 682,724 cars. The company also approved four compressed bio gas projects with a budget of ₹561 crore.

articles.title: Bloomberg delays India’s entry to global bond index yet again
articles.content: The inclusion of Indian government bonds in Bloomberg's Global Aggregate Index has been deferred yet again, as the company requires additional evaluation of both operational and market infrastructure components. This setback could lead to an immediate uptick in sovereign bond yields, surprising investors who were hopeful for increased foreign capital inflow. Meanwhile, Indian bonds remain part of various other emerging market debt indexes.

articles.title: IDBI's unlisted share sales not a public issue: Sebi
articles.content: Sebi has clarified that IDBI Bank can sell unlisted shares privately. These transactions will not be considered public issues by the regulator. This clarification allows for privately negotiated deals with identified buyers. IDBI Bank sought this guidance for its holdings in unlisted companies. The move facilitates secondary transfers of equity shares under specific conditions.

articles.title: Strong earnings, FPI inflows keep Indian equities resilient despite global risks
articles.content: Indian equity indices wrapped up July on a high note, achieving their best monthly performance in three months with significant gains. The robust corporate earnings played a critical role in alleviating fears related to rising oil prices. The Nifty and Sensex jumped over 2.5% in the week and nearly 2.1% throughout July.

articles.title: Sebi disposes of case against Religare Enterprises, Saluja, other persons
articles.content: Sebi has concluded legal actions against Religare Enterprises and its former chairperson.  The regulator found no further directions were needed after the open offer.  Proceedings were initiated alleging Religare failed to cooperate with the mandatory open offer.  The company had questioned the Burman Group's 'fit and proper' status and delayed approvals.  The open offer's completion achieved the remedial objective of Sebi's proceedings.
